0022600111.text: The Suns (0-1, 15th in the West, 5th in the Pacific and 1.5 games back) host the Warriors (0-2, 13th in the West, 3rd in the Pacific and 2 games back) for their first home game of the season. The teams have no games yet in the 2026-27 season series, while Phoenix lost the 2025-26 series 1-3, including a 101-97 loss in Phoenix on February 5, 2026. Phoenix is without Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery) and Oso Ighodaro (out, oblique strain), while Golden State is without Al Horford, Brandin Podziemski, and Draymond Green (all out, back), Jimmy Butler III (out, knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (out, illness), Moses Moody (out, knee surgery), Stephen Curry (out, rest), and Charles Bassey (day-to-day, knee, game-time decision).
